queue.pick_tooltip: Pick several videos at once to make a queue
queue.select_hint: Click a video to see and change its choices below. You can also drag videos into the window.
queue.state.skipped: The Claude round was not finished
queue.start_hint: First the program listens to all the videos without you (this can run overnight). Then you and Claude take them one at a time, and finally the program makes the new videos by itself. The queue waits when it is your turn.
queue.cannot_start: The video could not be started. Choose it again and try again.
queue.drop_rest:
The video has been stopped.

Stop the rest of the queue too?

Choose No to go on with the next video.
queue.resume_ask:
A queue of {n} videos was interrupted before it finished ({left} left).

Do you want to carry on where it stopped?
queue.work_hint: The queue waits for you when it is your turn and carries on by itself afterwards. Videos that go wrong are skipped.
queue.nothing_new: There was nothing new to make
queue.next_hint: Choose new videos when you are ready. The text files (.srt) are reused if you make more versions.
queue.next_hint_retry: Try the ones that did not finish again, or choose new videos.
